title: AI Infrastructure Supercycle
summary: AI infrastructure capital expenditure may remain elevated over the next several years, supporting indexes and domestic funds with large exposure to semiconductors, cloud platforms, and data center assets.
causalChain: AI workload demand grows
Cloud and platform companies maintain elevated infrastructure capex
Semiconductor, cloud, and data center assets receive earnings support
Indexes with high technology exposure reflect the theme
keyAssumptions: AI workloads continue to scale beyond initial training demand
Large platform companies can fund capex without severe margin damage
Supply constraints do not fully block deployment
invalidationConditions: Major cloud providers cut AI capex for multiple quarters
AI monetization fails to support continued infrastructure spending
Semiconductor supply or regulation sharply constrains deployment

title: China Asset Valuation Recovery
summary: Chinese and Hong Kong assets may recover from depressed valuation levels if policy support, earnings stabilization, and risk appetite improve together.
causalChain: Policy support improves market expectations
Earnings revisions stabilize
Risk appetite recovers from depressed levels
China and Hong Kong broad and technology indexes re-rate
keyAssumptions: Policy follow-through is strong enough to change earnings expectations
Property and consumption drag do not worsen materially
Foreign and domestic flows stop deteriorating
invalidationConditions: Policy support fails to improve credit or consumption data

title: Gold Long-term Allocation Value
summary: Gold may retain long-term allocation value if real-rate uncertainty, geopolitical risk, and reserve diversification remain persistent.
causalChain: Real-rate and currency uncertainty remains elevated
Central-bank reserve diversification continues
Portfolio hedging demand supports gold allocation
Commodity and global allocation views reflect the hedge value
keyAssumptions: Real yields do not rise enough to erase gold demand
Geopolitical risk premium does not fully normalize
invalidationConditions: Real yields rise sharply and remain elevated
Central-bank buying weakens for a sustained period
Risk appetite normalizes and hedge demand falls materially

title: US Tech Valuation Risk
summary: US technology indexes may face valuation compression risk if earnings growth fails to keep pace with elevated expectations or if discount rates stay restrictive.
causalChain: US technology valuations remain elevated
Earnings expectations are high
Restrictive rates or slower earnings growth pressure multiples
Technology-heavy indexes become more sensitive to downside surprises
keyAssumptions: Earnings growth expectations are vulnerable to disappointment
Rates do not fall fast enough to offset valuation risk
invalidationConditions: Earnings growth broadens and beats expectations sustainably
Rates decline while growth remains resilient
Valuation risk is absorbed through earnings rather than price declines

title: USD Liquidity Cycle
summary: Global risk assets may remain sensitive to changes in USD liquidity, rate expectations, and dollar strength.
causalChain: USD liquidity conditions shape global risk appetite
Dollar strength affects non-US assets and QDII execution
Rate expectations influence equity duration risk
Global and emerging-market exposure reacts to liquidity changes
keyAssumptions: Dollar liquidity remains a major driver of cross-asset risk appetite
Currency pressure affects domestic access to global funds
invalidationConditions: Dollar volatility falls and liquidity becomes stable
Rate expectations stop driving equity factor rotation
Global risk appetite decouples from USD liquidity indicators
